Home.welcomeTitle: Welcome to Isipathana International Meditation Center
Home.welcomeDescription: In today's fast-moving world, moments of true calm have become rare treasures. At Isipathana International Meditation Center, we offer a welcoming, peaceful space where people of all ages can learn and deepen meditation skills, practice mindfulness in a supportive community, and access tools for stress relief and emotional balance. Here, the door is always open to anyone seeking a moment of stillness.
Home.programDescription: Our center offers a range of programs tailored to meet the needs of individuals, families, organizations, and visitors from around the world — including daily guided meditation, specialized classes in Buddhist Psychology and Therapy, stress management workshops, corporate wellness packages, mindfulness programs for children and teens, and cultural immersion experiences for foreign visitors.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our meditation programs and center.
FAQ.q1: What programs does the center offer?
FAQ.a1: We offer a wide range of programs including Daily Guided Meditation, specialized classes in Buddhist Psychology and Therapy, Stress Management & Mindfulness Workshops, Corporate Wellness Packages for government and private sector workplaces, Mindfulness for Children & Teens, and Meditation & Cultural Immersion programs for foreign visitors. We also host monthly Mindfulness Circles and free meditation days for the public.
FAQ.q2: Do I need prior experience to join?
FAQ.a2: Not at all! We welcome everyone regardless of age, background, or belief. Our programs are designed for beginners and experienced practitioners alike. Whether you are new to meditation or looking to deepen your practice, our experienced guides will support you every step of the way.
FAQ.q3: Is there a cost for the programs?
FAQ.a3: Many of our programs, including free meditation days for the public, are offered at no charge and supported by donations (Dana). Some specialized workshops, retreats, and corporate wellness packages may have fees to cover materials and logistics. We believe mindfulness should be accessible to all.
FAQ.q4: Can I stay at the temple?
FAQ.a4: Our center is located at Isipathanaramaya Temple in Meddawatta, Matara. We plan to offer a unique monastic life experience where participants can live simply, follow a disciplined routine, and practice meditation. Please contact us for current availability and upcoming retreat schedules.
FAQ.q5: Who guides the sessions at the center?
FAQ.a5: Our programs are guided by Rev. Sudhamma Nahangoda Thero, a respected monk and scholar within the Theravāda Buddhist tradition, serving as the Special Representative of the Estonian Theravāda Sangha in Sri Lanka. With deep expertise in Pāli, Buddhist Psychology, and meditation, he ensures all teachings are rooted in authenticity, clarity, and a profound respect for the Buddha's teachings.

About.heroSubtitle: A sanctuary where every person can step beyond the boundaries of stress, fear, and limitation, and awaken to a life of clarity, compassion, and purpose.
About.missionDescription: To offer spaces and practical techniques that nurture inner peace, mindful living, and spiritual growth. To welcome all regardless of age, background, or belief into a community built on kindness and respect. To inspire people to integrate mindfulness into daily life, so peace is not an escape, but a way of being.
About.mettaDescription: Cultivating an attitude of unconditional kindness and goodwill towards all beings.
About.satiDescription: Developing present-moment awareness and a clear, non-judgmental attention.
About.pannaDescription: Gaining direct, experiential insight into the nature of reality.
About.storyDescription: In today's fast-moving world, moments of true calm have become rare treasures. We have seen friends, family, and colleagues struggling with stress, anxiety, and a constant sense of being 'on.' This inspired us to create a space where the noise of life fades away — a place designed entirely for peace, presence, and personal growth. Isipathana International Meditation Center was born from this vision, rooted at the serene Isipathanaramaya Temple in Matara, Sri Lanka, guided by the authentic teachings of the Theravāda Buddhist tradition.
About.teachersSubtitle: Our center is guided by experienced and dedicated teachers committed to sharing the authentic path of mindfulness and compassion rooted in the Theravāda Buddhist tradition.
